method_notes:
实际D1代码不是每群只有一个名称：它允许1至3个主题，要求原文引句，允许无法确定，也已有独立于Cluster的Technology散列ID和Cluster/Patent多对多表。D1以名称、对象、手段的字符串散列合并记录，尚无D2的逐族贡献层、源文坐标及双侧机制等价审计。
本对照复刻的是D1群级命名与逐字引文检查阶段，未复制D1后来另做的助手语义审计，不能将它当作旧D1完整最终审定结果。
本表是核心冻结之后、同一30B模型上新做的D1式对照，复用原SYSTEM、最多8个中心/边缘/随机/多样代表、摘要前1200字符和原逐字引文检查。不是冒充D1历史结果。部分控制池仅为本轮抽样；Noise原方法不命名，这里采用冻结60族中的均匀8族作为明确适配。
D2阅读更多原文、允许单源机制候选并有助手修订；D1门槛至少3个Family ID，原文重复另计。两种不确定率和节点数单位不同，不能直接比较准确率。表中D1引文PASS仅为字面匹配，不是语义正确。D2多节点不等于真实技术拆分率；当前没有独立人类Gold、同成本精确率或全量机制Recall。D2的价值首先在可逐族追溯、保留不同限定及机制关系审计。实际调用成本含所有失败和重试，详见Manifest。

docs.title: Thermoelectric conversion device
docs.abstract: This thermoelectric conversion device includes a plurality of thermoelectric conversion modules comprising: an insulating support body having flexibility; a plurality of p-type thermoelectric conversion layers and n-type thermoelectric conversion layers formed in an alternating manner on one surface of the support body with an interval resulting from the support body therebetween; and connecting electrodes that electrically connect a p-type thermoelectric conversion layer and an n-type thermoelectric conversion layer adjacent to each other on the support body. docs.abstract: Piezoelectric micromachined ultrasonic transducer (pMUT) arrays and techniques for frequency shaping in pMUT arrays are described, for example to achieve both high frequency and low frequency operation in a same device. In embodiments, various sizes of piezoelectric membranes are fabricated for tuning resonance frequency across the membranes. The variously sized piezoelectric membranes are lumped together by two or more separate electrode rails, enabling independent addressing between the two or more subgroups of sized transducer elements. Signal processing of the drive and/or response signals generated and/or received from each of the two or more electrode rails may achieve a variety of operative modes for the device, such as a near field mode, a far field mode, and an ultra wide bandwidth mode.

docs.title: Method and device for forming thin film
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To form a vapor deposited thin film with high vapor deposition efficiency in vapor depositing a thin film of metal or the like on the surface of a substrate by focusing the vapor flow for vapor deposition with a diffusion preventing device and rediating the same to the substrate surface. CONSTITUTION:An open type hearth 3 is placed in a casing 1, and a vapor source 4 of Ag, Cr, Co, Fe, Ni, and other materials to be vapor-deposited is placed thereon, and is heated with an electron beam type heater 5, whereby vapor flow V of these metal is generated. The vapor flow V enters a vapor flow diffusion preventing device 6 through its wide inlet, and is released through an upper narrow outlet together with the main vapor flow while impinging upon and reflecting on the heated inside wall. It is vapor-deposited on the surface of a substrate W by passing through the hole parts of a focusing electrode 14 connected to the negative electrode of an electric power source 12. While the substrate W is transferred with a rotating cooling can 13, the thin vapor deposition film is formed on the surface at uniform thickness efficiently.

docs.title: Vapor deposition device
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To provide vapor-deposited films of a uniform thickness on many substrates with one time of vapor deposition treatment by providing a supporting body for a vapor source at the center of a vacuum vessel in the position equidistant from respective substrate holders, and moving the vapor source vertically along the supporting body. CONSTITUTION:Substrate holders 3 are mounted to the cryogenic panels 2 disposed in a bell-jar 1, and substrates 4 are fixed and held to the holders 3. A supporting body 5 for a vapor source is located on the centerline of the bell-jar 1, and a vapor source 6 contg. evaporating materials 7 is supported to said body. The source 6 is moved vertically along the body 5 according to adequate scanning parameters. Vapor-deposited films of a uniform thickness are obtained by such device, and the number of the large area substrates to be treated per batch is increased.

docs.abstract: To provide a plasma processing method capable of performing plasma processing with high productivity by suppressing mixture of a carrier gas and stably generating plasma even in a case where a conveyance speed of a long workpiece is made high when performing the plasma processing while conveying the workpiece in a length direction in a roll-to-roll manner.SOLUTION: A plasma processing method for performing plasma processing between opposed electrode pairs by inserting a long workpiece between the opposed electrode pairs while conveying the workpiece in a length direction includes supplying a gas for plasma generation from a gas supply section, which is disposed at an upstream side of one electrode of the opposed electrode pairs in a conveyance direction of the workpiece, and feeding a part of the gas for plasma generation supplied from the gas supply section to an upstream side of a conveyance path of the workpiece. An average flow velocity Vave of the gas for plasma generation fed to the upstream side and a conveyance speed U of the workpiece satisfy 2≤6×Vave/U≤20.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

docs.title: Micro vacuum tube
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a micro vacuum tube having little cathode deterioration, and stable and approximately uniform electric characteristics. CONSTITUTION:A higher voltage than the voltage applied between a cathode electrode 2 and a main electrode 3 is applied between the cathode electrode 2 and an anode electrode 4. Further, the cathode electrode 2 is irradiate by light from EL luminescent elements 6a and 6b. Accordingly, electrons are emitted from the cathode 2 receiving energy from an electric field generated by the voltage applied between the cathode 2 and the anode 4, and the energy by light irradiation. Thereafter, the electrons are attracted by the main electrode 3, to which the higher voltage than that of the anode electrode 4 is applied, and collides with a fluorescent layer 5 formed on the main electrode 3 with a high speed so that the fluorescent layer 5 emits light.

docs.title: Production of thin alloy film
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To apply always a specified amt. of a non-essential component on a thin film at a high filming speed in a method for forming a thin alloy film on a substrate in a vacuum by directing the vapor flow of one material and the sputtering particles of the other material simultaneously toward the substrate. CONSTITUTION:Co which is an essential component is evaporated by heating on a substrate of a synthetic resin film; at the same time, a slight amt. of Cr which is a non-essential component to be incorporated is sputtered, in the production of, for example, a vertical magnetization recording medium of a non-coated type. The resulted vapor flow of Co and the sputtering particles of Cr are directed simultaneously toward the substrate film. Since the essential component is vapor-deposited by ion plating, the filming speed is high. Since the non-essential component is filmed by sputtering, always a specified amt. can be added into the thin film and the filming speed over the entire part is not affected by the low speed with the sputtering as the non-essential component is very slight in content.

docs.title: Sublimation refining apparatus
docs.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a sublimation refining apparatus capable of increasing sublimation efficiency further even when not only a crude material having high thermal stability but also a crude material having low thermal stability are used as samples.SOLUTION: Provided is a sublimation refining apparatus having a sublimation pipe, a vacuum pump and piping connecting the sublimation pipe and the vacuum pump. docs.abstract: To provide a measurement terminal device, a slope measurement method and program that may use a measurement terminal device to do a stable slope measurement of a house, etc. and allow anybody to easily perform a stable slope measurement of a house, etc. A terminal posture detection is carried out that detects whether or not the slope of a measurement terminal device (10) with respect to the horizontal direction is within a specified range, the measurement terminal device (10) being in a plane in parallel with a wall to be measured, first assist information that assists the terminal posture detection is displayed on a display device (102), a wall slope measurement is carried out that measures the slope of the wall with respect to the vertical direction according to measurement data of an acceleration sensor (204), and the result of the wall slope measurement is stored in a memory (202).

docs.title: Carrying control device of unmanned carrier vehicle
docs.abstract: PURPOSE: To prevent a loading station in which a buffer is caused to overflow by carried articles to be carried out. CONSTITUTION: A carried article 3 of a buffer 7 is detected to detect the number of carried articles by a detector 6 of each station at an instruction waiting place of an unmanned carrier vehicle 5. The number of unalloted carried articles of a buffer of each station is calculated from information on the number or detected carried articles and the alloted carried articles. A buffer free area estimated value in the case where a carrier vehicle reaches each station is calculated from the moving time M from the instruction waiting time to each station, carried article carrying-out time interval Pi as buffer data, carried article storage possible number Ki, and the number Bi of unalloted carried articles by the following expression. (Ki-Bi)-Mi/Pi (i=1, 2,..., n).  Carried articles are alloted in order from a loading station with the minimum value among the above estimated values for the unmanned transport vehicle to the loading possible number.

docs.title: Method for detecting ovarian cancer and method for suppresssing the same
docs.abstract:
An object of the present invention is to provide a method for detecting cancer through identification of genes exhibiting characteristic behavior in the cases of cancer such as ovarian cancer, and a cell growth inhibitor. The present invention provides a method for detecting cancer, which comprises detecting canceration including malignancy of a specimen through detection of at least one alteration of a gene existing in a chromosomal region 2q14. 2, 3p24. 1, 3q26. 2, 3q29, 4q34. 2, 6q23, 9p21. 3, 11q13. 3, 13q22.1, 13q33. 1, 13q33. 3, 15q12, 15q15. 1, 17p12, 17p13. 1, 17p13. 3, 18q21. 1, 18q21. 2,18q21. 31, 18q21. 32, 18q21. 33, 18q23, 20q13. 13, 20q13. 2, 20q13. 31, 20q13. 33, Xp11. 23, Xp13.1, Xp13. 3, Xp26. 2, Xp26. 3, or Xq28 in the specimen. 
The gene can be CTGF, ENPP1, ENPP3, CRSP3, ARG, AKAP7, EPB41L2, KIAA1913. Homozygons deletion of these genes occures in ovarian cancer.

docs.title: Method for preparation of printing plate by electrophotographic process
docs.abstract:
A method for preparation of a printing plate by an electrophotographic process comprising providing a peelable transfer layer (T) containing a resin (A) capable of being removed upon a chemical reaction treatment on an electrophotographic light-sensitive element, forming a toner image on the transfer layer by an electrophotographic process, providing an adhesive layer (M) containing a thermoplastic resin (B) only on the toner image, transferring the toner image together with the transfer layer (T) and the adhesive layer (M) from the electrophotographic light-sensitive element to a primary receptor, transferring the toner image together with the transfer layer (T) and the adhesive layer (M) from the primary receptor to a receiving material having a surface capable of providing a hydrophilic surface suitable for lithographic printing at the time of printing, and then removing the transfer layer (T) in the non-image portion on the receiving material by the chemical reaction treatment.

docs.title: Contact charging chip
docs.abstract: PURPOSE: To provide a contact charging device with very simple configuration as a charger device for a photoreceptor to be used in a copying machine, laser printer, etc. CONSTITUTION: A plastic film 1 subjected to an electroconductivity processing has at the tip a contact electrostatically charging chip 4, and one end of this plastic film is dipped in a solution of a semi-electroconductive material so that the film end is coated therewith, and thus a semi-electroconductive coating film 2 is formed, and its foremost part is contacted with a photoreceptor 5 in such a way as directed in the rotating direction. The electroconductivity processing should favorably consist of a process to form a metal evaporation film on the surface of the plastic film 1, and it is also preferable that a protection film is provided on the evaporation film. It may also be acceptable that this contact charging device is composed of a plurality of contact charging chips 4.
